name: flp_inspect
title: FLP Inspect
description: Inspect offline FL Studio project structure (metadata, tempo, channels, patterns, mixer routing, playlist) without launching FL.

file.description: Path to the FL Studio project file (.flp).

fields.description: Optional list of sections to inspect ('all', 'metadata', 'channels', 'patterns', 'mixer', 'playlist').

max_channels.description: Maximum number of channel summaries to return (default: 100).

max_patterns.description: Maximum number of pattern summaries to return (default: 100).

include_empty_tracks.description: Whether to include default/empty mixer tracks (default: false).
